svg.text: Complete user question → evidence retrieval → validated answer flow
Numbered in execution order. Blue arrows = calls / forward flow. Green arrows = results / responses. Boxes = processing within a component.
Question ≤ 6000 chars; PNG / JPEG / WebP ≤ 5 MB
Load recent history + topic + guided workflow state
Inventory shortcut shown below; continue for technical Q
08 Planner request: question + recent context + optional photo
09 QueryPlan: search text, topic, follow-up, media needs
Clarify / reject scope when needed; preserve follow-up topic
13 Parameterized SQL: document_chunks + cosine distance + keyword bonus
14 Ranked seed chunks; retain candidates per explicit machine
15 Expand selected document pages; enrich images / tables / links / sections
16 Selected chunks + geometry + relationships + media metadata
17 Read verified QR links for selected machines / documents / pages
19 Load relevant manual images / original PDF when required
20 Asset bytes for image normalization / PDF-page rendering
Validate relevant URLs; keep provenance and load warnings
Short evidence IDs + workflow + recent context + image bytes
23 ADK agent: approved evidence + allowed media + optional user photo
Reject unknown IDs; map short IDs to real chunk IDs
Text / tables / images + descriptions / links / sources
Session memory stores workflow, history and response assets
28 JSON: blocks + warnings + session_id + expiry + elapsed time
Image route serves assets from backend memory
32 Render final answer: text, tables, images, video / QR / source links
ALTERNATE PATHS — controlled by the backend
GROUP BY machine + document in BigQuery
OFFLINE KNOWLEDGE PREPARATION — populates the stores used above
PDF page / image → Document AI → review extracted URLs → save only verified QR destinations in BigQuery.
Shared embedding model: gemini-embedding-001. Chat performs cloud reads; offline ingestion and verified QR utilities write persistent data.
BOUNDARIES: user photos support observation; manuals provide technical evidence. The agent receives prepared evidence, not arbitrary database tools.
Sessions / response images live in backend memory, expire within one hour, and clear on restart. /health is a process check. QR decoding remains unverified.
Source verified against frontend/src, backend/app, src/simple_ingestion and backend/scripts · 16 October 2026 · Implemented flow, not deployment topology.
